versions.changelog:
Drafting fixes
  - Fixed the "Hi ," greeting bug — when sender-name extraction returned an empty
    first name, the greeting rendered with a dangling space before the comma.
    Now collapses cleanly to "Hi," instead. Regression test pins this.

  Ops / operability
  - New `/readyz` endpoint for launchd/health probes (reports DB resolvability).
  - `/healthz` now returns the runtime version. A regression test pins that
    `/healthz`, `/readyz`, and `/api/config` all report the same `get_version()`,
    so the version drift across runtime surfaces that used to bite occasionally
    can't quietly come back.
  - `youos doctor` now distinguishes "Python `mlx_lm` package not importable in
    this venv" from "global `mlx_lm` binary on PATH" — the error no longer
    reads as contradicting a visible `which mlx_lm`.

  Skill metadata + safety surfacing
  - SKILL.md gains a prominent **Safety & impact** section near the top
    (sensitive Gmail/Docs/WhatsApp ingestion, install runs local code, opt-in
    launchd, opt-in nightly, optional cloud fallback + strict-local instructions),
    plus a **Naming** line clarifying that *<First>OS* is your local instance
    under `YOUOS_DATA_DIR`, not a fork of the project.
  - `clawhub.json` no longer references screenshot/demo assets that aren't
    inside the strict text-only bundle (the homepage repo resolves them).

  Requires Apple Silicon + Python 3.11+. Public beta.

What's new in 0.2.0-beta.18
 - Light mode 🌓: a full light theme alongside the original dark one — across the web UI (drafting, stats, settings, about, the setup wizard), the landing page, and the Gmail extension  panel + bookmarklet. Follows your system appearance by default (prefers-color-scheme),  with a ☀/☾ toggle that remembers your choice. Dark mode is unchanged.

Also: a fix so the login and bookmarklet-popup pages style correctly.

A major release. The headline: YouOS now drafts in your voice on a **local model by default** — and we measured that it beats the cloud at sounding like you.

  Local & private by default
  - Drafts run on your own fine-tuned model (Qwen + your LoRA), served warm so it's fast and fully on-device. The cloud is only a cold-start before your model is trained, or an optional fallback you can switch off.
  - New `youos compare-models` drafts your held-out replies under each backend and scores them against what you actually wrote ("voice-match") — so you can verify the local model wins on your mail.

  Runs standalone (no longer OpenClaw-only)
  - One-command install: `./scripts/install.sh` (sets up the MLX model + runs the doctor).
  - Pick how it reaches Gmail/Docs with one line — `gog` (default), Google's `gws` CLI, or the native Google API.

  Guided setup & control
  - Browser onboarding wizard (`/welcome`): identity, ingestion, fine-tune, background service, API token.
  - Settings page + `youos config` for toggling features without editing YAML.
  - Run it reliably as a login service: `youos service install`.

  Drafts inside Gmail
  - A browser extension (Chrome/Edge/Brave) drafts in your voice, inserts into the reply box, and learns from your rating.

 No silent failures
  - Per-draft model badge + a "Drafting with" status show which model actually ran.
  - A readiness gate holds you back from relying on drafts until your model is trained *and* benchmarked.
  - Failures link to "How to fix" steps.

  Smarter & self-improving
  - Multi-candidate generation + ranking, adaptive decoding, a post-generation repair pass, and nightly autoresearch weighted by draft quality.
  - Setup personalizes the app's name from your first name (YouOS → e.g. BaherOS).

  Requires Apple Silicon + Python 3.11+. Public beta.

Version 0.1.19

- Major onboarding, install, and Gmail integration improvements.
- Added browser extension for Gmail (Chrome/Edge/Brave) with in-Gmail drafting, insertion, and feedback panel.
- New script-based installer (`./scripts/install.sh`) that sets up Python venv, MLX local model, and dependencies.
- Simplified Google account ingestion: supports `gog` (default), `gws`, and native Google API OAuth flows (configurable).
- Added local model warm server (`mlx_lm.server`) for faster on-device draft generation.
- Added commands for model comparison, backend selection, and local/remote draft models.
- Removed legacy install/run scripts; clarified privacy, credentials, and fallback settings in documentation.

- Added a new "Safety / impact" section to the documentation, summarizing privacy and install considerations before first-time installation.
- Clarified that persistence/background service and nightly improvement automation are opt-in/manual, not automatic.
- Reorganized instructions to highlight that external model fallback and automation are optional.
- No code changes in this release; documentation only.

- Added new launchd management scripts: `install_youos_launchd.sh`, `run_youos_launchd.sh`, `run_youos_server.sh`, and `uninstall_youos_launchd.sh`.
- Improved integration with macOS by introducing launchd automation support for setup and process management.

- Removed `screenshots` and `demo` fields from `clawhub.json` to avoid metadata/package mismatch.
- Clarified manual install/source-review expectations in metadata/description.
Trust cleanup: removed screenshot/demo metadata not present in strict bundle; clarified manual install/source-review note; metadata parity improvements.
- Added a note under Install and runtime model clarifying that pip install -e . executes local package code and users should review source before installing.

- Added detailed install instructions and system requirements metadata to improve setup clarity (manual venv creation, pip install, min RAM, platform).
- Introduced new metadata sections for required/optional credentials, and explicit privacy information including local data storage paths and networking.
- No changes to skill code; documentation and manifest only.

- Added robust data-preservation hardening to prevent instance mixups, silent data regressions, and unsafe DB path usage.
- Added built-in snapshot and restore tooling (API + CLI) for safer recovery workflows.
- Added startup safety checks and machine-readable health reporting.

1) CI safety fix
- Fix narrow low-signal filter to avoid dropping valid training pairs

2) Draft quality improvements
- Implement sender-type style anchors and exemplar cache
- Adds sender-type style anchoring in draft prompting.
- Adds exemplar cache logic for more consistent draft selection.

3) Persistence + onboarding defaults
- Implement persistent exemplar cache and quickstart default; fix syntax
- Persists exemplar cache in SQLite (`exemplar_cache` table) across restarts.
- Wires cache read/write/clear through API + generation paths.
- Sets quickstart-first onboarding defaults.
- Fixes syntax issue in generation service.

4) Dashboard metrics visibility
- Display edit-reduction metrics in dashboard
- Surfaces edit-distance and high-rating deltas in stats UI.

• Prepared minimal review package to reduce scanner noise.
• Aligned metadata and requirements (python3, gog, darwin, arm64).
• Hardened defaults and disclosures:
• local-first fallback default (model.fallback: none)
• localhost bind default (127.0.0.1)
• setup now generates a PIN if left blank
• clarified privacy/external-fallback behavior in docs.

Aligned skill metadata and docs to address security-review feedback:
- Clarified manual pip install model (full local app, not instruction-only)
- Clarified required dependencies (python3 + gog)
- Added credential/config transparency (YOUOS_DATA_DIR, optional Claude fallback)
- Clarified privacy behavior and strict local-only option (model.fallback: none)
- Synced docs/UI wording and removed stale references to deprecated controls.

- Added optional Reply instruction in Draft UI (works for inbound replies too).
- Added optional instruction field in Gmail bookmarklet popup.
- Passed user_prompt through both generation paths (/draft/stream + /feedback/generate).
- Fixed bookmarklet reliability issues.
- Synced docs/UI to reflect current behavior and removed stale controls.
- Standardized version metadata to 0.1.7.

v0.1.7: added optional reply instruction across Draft + bookmarklet popup, wired user_prompt through stream/non-stream generation, fixed bookmarklet reliability, synchronized docs/UI and version metadata.
